bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service | grep -qx active || exit 71
systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service | grep -qx enabled || exit 72
python3 - <<'PY'
import asyncio,sys
sys.path.insert(0,"scripts")
from userbot_topic_audit_client import inspect
async def check():
 for chat,topic in [(-1002373696859,1605),(-1003770334893,4)]:
  result=await inspect(chat,-topic)
  rows=result.get("rows")
  if not isinstance(rows,list) or len(rows)!=1 or rows[0].get("topic_id")!=topic:raise RuntimeError("AUDIT_SCOPE_INVALID")
  row=rows[0]
  if row.get("pin_state")!="PRESENT":raise RuntimeError("PIN_NOT_PRESENT")
  if "REPEATED_START_DEEPLINK" not in row.get("pin_transports",[]):raise RuntimeError("PIN_URL_BUTTON_NOT_OBSERVED")
 await asyncio.sleep(0)
asyncio.run(check())
PY
systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service | grep -qx active || exit 73
systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service | grep -qx enabled || exit 74
